关键词: President’s Advisory Council on Financial Capability for Young Americans
主要内容: On March 10, 2014, the U.S. Department of the Treasury hosted an inaugural public meeting of the President’s Advisory Council on Financial Capability for Young Americans. Secretary Jacob J. Lew delivered opening remarks, emphasizing the importance of promoting financial capability among young Americans to increase upward economic mobility. The meeting included participation from key officials such as Secretary Arne Duncan of the Department of Education and Director Richard Cordray of the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau. The event was open to the press, with media required to RSVP by March 7 and provide personal details for access. A live webcast was also available for those unable to attend in person.
